title: Patriots add $400,000 signing bonus to honor Mack Hollins' receptions incentive

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Patriots add $400,000 signing bonus to honor Mack Hollins' receptions incentive
sources.description: Patriots receiver Mack Hollins was having a solid 2025 season when he suffered a lacerated spleen in December, causing him to miss the last two regular-season games.
